name: weather station
description: A mast with a panel that counts sols, shows the air temperature now, pulses a signal every Mars hour, and raises a red flag when it is colder than -70 C.
author: sample

did_you_know.text: At Jezero the air at 1.45 m typically falls to about 193 K (-80 C) just before dawn and climbs to about 257 K (-16 C) mid-afternoon, measured by Perseverance over a full Mars year.
